isolation_review.reason: Existing function-isolated repositories/runtimes and disposable installer homes; file groups preserve module/session fixture semantics. Worker envelope isolates HOME, native homes, runtime/distribution/harness state and temporary directories. Changed/unclassified files serialize; source, fixture and full outcome accounting remain mandatory.
isolation_review.additional_reason: These focused implementation tests use per-test tmp_path copies/private owned-process directories and restored function monkeypatches. Actual worker/session/index/home/log/signal/descendant isolation was exercised through E336/E337/E342; both platform observation contracts through E347/E348. They retain complete file groups and every autouse fixture. Full-source closure and fixture-source validation remain mandatory; missing/drifted proof serializes. test_git_memo.py, test_decision_window.py (both platforms) and installer test_workspace_activity_capture.py use only the per-test repository copy, tmp_path and restored monkeypatches (2026-10-23). Isolation review 2026-10-23 of the Phase 3 test files added since the original review (launcher-era runtime/editorial/planning/publication/activity/readiness/receipt suites): each uses tmp_path repositories, homes, installer state and owned child processes (launched/repo fixtures, disposable alctl installs); no fixed host paths, ports, shared registries or foreign-process signalling (only self-directed signals). test_artifact_consumers.py, test_review_state.py and test_baseline_exceptions.py (both platforms) use only per-test repository copies, tmp_path and restored monkeypatches (2026-10-23). Claude test_model_slots.py uses only the per-test repository copy and runtime (2026-10-23).
